title: A unified treatment of degenerate nonlocal elliptic problems
summary: We develop a unified framework for a broad class of nonlocal elliptic problems, encompassing a wide spectrum of nonlocal terms, including the classical Kirchhoff and Carrier-type equations as particular cases, and nonlinearities having sublinear or asymptotically linear growth. By combining the study of a suitable auxiliary problem and fixed-point techniques with careful parameter analysis, we establish existence, non-existence, and multiplicity results for positive solutions.
